scalars.scalar_value: Experience as a occupational therapy assistant.

items.item_text: Eligibility for certification by the National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy, Inc.
California License, or eligibility, to practice Occupational Therapy.
Basic Life Support - CPR through American Heart Association.
Experience as a occupational therapy assistant.

Implements effective and adequate treatment following department guidelines. Performs ongoing assessment of treatment effectiveness. Goals and treatment are modified as appropriate in relation to working toward goals. Selects appropriate treatment interventions, utilizes specialized techniques, and ensures patient safety with follow-up as recommended. Provides treatment for multiple diagnoses and levels of care.

Addresses patient/family education using a variety of teaching methods appropriate to the patient's level of understanding. Education is provided in a timely manner, with comprehensive content including all aspects of care and safety. Patient/family performance and the need for follow-up are documented.

Complies with department policy regarding documentation. Records are completed in a timely, concise, and legible manner using correct medical terminology and abbreviations. Documentation reflects all interventions used in treatment, patient response, progress toward goals, and communication with the delegating therapist regarding treatment plan modifications. Timecards, productivity logs, and billing are completed in a timely manner.

Appropriately communicates treatment plan and patient status with the healthcare team and MD. Participates in team conferences and verifies payor guidelines and authorizations as needed. Notifies the MD of patient concerns or changes in status. Collaborates with the primary Occupational Therapist regarding patient progress, goal updates, and discharge planning.
Demonstrates appropriate time management to meet department productivity standards and completes projects within established time frame
Graduation from an approved Occupational Therapy Assistant program.
